# Script positions at any depth: a `namespace eval` body, a `proc` body,
# `if`, `foreach`, `catch` and `while` bodies, a `[cmd]` inside a quoted
# word -- the places Tcl runs code.
exec sh -c | shell | { | sh | - | "ls | wc -l"
exec bash -c | shell | { | bash | - | "echo one; echo two"
exec sh -c | shell | { | sh | - | "a && b"
